$comment: H6 day restrictions and H9 activity fixed slots. The client dataset provides NONE (no dayRestrictions, activity_groups.fixed_slots not exported). Entries here are matched by curriculumKey + item name. Example dayRestriction: { "curriculumKey": "Class 5", "item": "Karate / Gymnastics / Band / Skating", "days": ["SATURDAY"] }. Example fixedSlot: { "curriculumKey": "Class 1", "item": "Happy Feet", "slots": [ { "day": "FRIDAY", "period": 9 }, { "day": "FRIDAY", "period": 10 } ] } (period omitted/null = any period that day, rule AC2).
